note: Dutch legal forms from the legal-form inventory, each with category, law, register and its own UBO rule text; entity_type maps the form onto the test of art. 3 Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018: corporate (a), other_legal_entity (c: foundation, association, cooperative), partnership (d), trust (e and lid 5: fund for joint account), branch (the foreign parent). Three foreign company forms are included because they occur in the ownership chain of the demo client; they are tested under the Dutch rule as companies.

legal_forms.ubo_rule: Art. 3(1)(a) Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018: natural persons holding >25% of shares, voting rights or ownership interest (directly or indirectly), or exercising control by other means (incl. consolidation tests of Boek 2 BW); fallback, after exhausting all means and absent suspicion, the senior managing officials (hoger leidinggevend personeel = all statutory directors, art. 3(6)); where a legal entity is a director, look through to its directors/UBOs.

legal_forms.registered_in: Handelsregister (KVK); UBO-register (listed NVs: only listing information)
legal_forms.ubo_rule: Same as BV (art. 3(1)(a) Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018): >25% shares/voting rights/ownership interest, incl. former bearer shares, or control by other means; fallback senior managing officials (all statutory directors). Listed NVs on a regulated market are exempt from UBO identification under the Wwft (and only register listing details).

Art. 3(1)(c) Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018 ('overige rechtspersoon'): natural persons with >25% ownership interest (e.g. a right to >25% of the assets/distributions), >25% of the votes on amendments of the articles, or actual control (e.g. a founder or third party with appointment/veto rights); in practice usually none, so fallback to senior managing officials = all statutory directors (bestuurders). For a STAK: also look at certificate holders as UBOs of the underlying company.

legal_forms.abbr: Vereniging (met volledige rechtsbevoegdheid / met beperkte rechtsbevoegdheid)
legal_forms.registered_in: Handelsregister (KVK); UBO-register (associations with full legal capacity; informal associations if registered)
legal_forms.ubo_rule: Art. 3(1)(c) Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018: natural persons with >25% ownership interest, >25% of votes on amendments of the articles, or actual control; with many members usually none, so fallback to senior managing officials (all directors).

Art. 3(1)(c) Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018: members with >25% ownership interest (share in capital/liquidation surplus), >25% of votes on amendments of the articles, or actual control; fallback senior managing officials (directors). Holding cooperatives often have 2–3 members, so look through the members.

legal_forms.law: Wetboek van Koophandel art. 16–34 jo. Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7A art. 7A:1655–7A:1688 (maatschap)
legal_forms.ubo_rule: Art. 3(1)(d) Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018: partners with >25% ownership interest, >25% of votes on amendments of the partnership agreement (where majority decisions apply), or actual control; fallback senior managing officials = each partner (art. 3(6)).

legal_forms.law: Wetboek van Koophandel art. 19–21 (jo. art. 16–34) and Boek 7A BW
legal_forms.registered_in: Handelsregister (KVK) (general partners named; limited partners' contributions registered without names in many cases – verify); UBO-register
legal_forms.ubo_rule: Art. 3(1)(d) Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018: partners (general or limited) with >25% ownership interest, >25% of votes on amendments of the partnership agreement, or actual control (typically via the general partner); fallback senior managing officials = each partner except a limited partner who only contributes capital (art. 3(6)); if general partner is a BV, look through to its UBOs/directors.

legal_forms.registered_in: Handelsregister (KVK) if it runs an enterprise or a profession; UBO-register for public (openbare) partnerships
legal_forms.ubo_rule: Art. 3(1)(d) Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018 (personenvennootschap): partners with >25% ownership interest, >25% of votes on amendments of the agreement, or actual control; fallback all partners (senior managing officials).

legal_forms.en: mutual fund (contractual fund for joint account)
legal_forms.law: Not a civil-law entity: contractual arrangement (fondsvoorwaarden) between manager (beheerder), legal owner/custodian (juridisch eigenaar, often a stichting bewaarder) and participants; tax definition in art. 2(3) Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969 (amended per 1 Jan 2025); Wft/AIFMD if offered as investment fund
legal_forms.registered_in: not registered in the Handelsregister as such (manager and custodian are); must register UBOs in the UBO-register voor trusts en soortgelijke juridische constructies (open and closed FGRs) – verify Handelsregister treatment
legal_forms.ubo_rule: Treated as a 'similar legal arrangement' to a trust (art. 3(1)(e) and 3(5) Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018): founder(s), the manager/legal owner in the trustee role, protector if any, beneficiaries/participants (participants >25% in practice), and any natural person with ultimate control; where the FGR is offered to 150 or more persons and managed by a licensed manager, the group of participants as a class is the UBO. KVK: the trustee (manager/beheerder) is always a UBO; legal-entity roles are looked through to their own UBOs/directors (art. 3(7)).

legal_forms.local: nevenvestiging / hoofdvestiging van een buitenlandse rechtspersoon (incl. formeel buitenlandse vennootschap)
legal_forms.law: Handelsregisterwet 2007 and Handelsregisterbesluit 2008; Wet op de formeel buitenlandse vennootschappen (WFBV) for pseudo-foreign companies
legal_forms.registered_in: Handelsregister (KVK) as foreign legal entity with branch; UBOs in the home-country register (Dutch UBO-register only if the foreign entity has its seat in NL – verify)
legal_forms.ubo_rule: Determine UBOs of the foreign legal entity under art. 3 Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018 (applied to comparable foreign forms, art. 3(2)–(4)): >25% ownership/votes or control, fallback senior managing officials of the foreign company.

legal_forms.local: BVI business company (company limited by shares)
legal_forms.abbr: Limited, Ltd., Corporation, Corp., Incorporated, Inc., Société Anonyme, S.A., Sociedad Anónima
legal_forms.law: BVI Business Companies Act (Revised Edition 2020), as amended by the BVI Business Companies (Amendment) Acts 2022 and 2024 (in force 2 Jan 2025)
legal_forms.ubo_rule: Natural person owning or controlling directly/indirectly 10% or more of shares or voting rights, or exercising control by other means (AML Regulations/Code of Practice and BO Regulations 2024); if none, the senior managing official; nominee shareholders must disclose their nominator.

legal_forms.local: Ιδιωτική εταιρεία περιορισμένης ευθύνης με μετοχές
legal_forms.law: Ο περί Εταιρειών Νόμος, Κεφ. 113 (Companies Law, Cap. 113), incl. s.29 (private company)
legal_forms.ubo_rule: Law 188(I)/2007 s.2: natural person ultimately owning or controlling the entity through a sufficient percentage of shares, voting rights or ownership interest - holding of 25% plus one share (direct or indirect) is evidence; control by other means per Companies Law criteria; if none identified after exhausting all means and no suspicion, the senior managing official (record steps taken).

legal_forms.law: Ley 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 sobre sociedades anónimas (arts. 1-89); Ley 47 de 2013 (custodia de acciones al portador); Ley 2 de 2011 (agente residente); Ley 52 de 2016 and Ley 254 de 2021 (registros contables)
legal_forms.ubo_rule: Ley 23 de 2015 art. 4(4) and art. 28; DE 35 de 2022: natural person who directly or indirectly owns 10% or more (financial obliged subjects) or 25% or more (non-financial obliged subjects and professionals) of the shares, participations or voting rights; plus any natural person exercising ultimate effective control by other means; only if none is identified, the person holding the highest administrative position (alto cargo administrativo). If the beneficial owner cannot be identified and doubt persists, do not start or continue the relationship (art. 28). Bearer-share companies: identify the real owner through the authorised custodian (art. 28(6)).
